question: The Digital Lok Adalat, powered by AI (Artificial Intelligence) and Blockchain, was launched by the then National Legal Services Authority Chairman ___________ during the 18th All India Legal Services Authorities’ meet held in Jaipur in July 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Uday Umesh Lalit**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Digital Lok Adalat, powered by AI and Blockchain, was launched during the 18th All India Legal Services Authorities' meet held in Jaipur in July 2022.
 
• It was launched by the then National Legal Services Authority Chairman **Justice Uday Umesh Lalit**.
